text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#4521 - inference-queue-depth > 90% for 6m, autoscaler lag detected :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Triggered by rule: autoscaler.queue.backlog.high (threshold=0.9, window=5m). Escalation policy: eng-oncall.

maya: acked. I'm on it, grabbing metrics now.

jonas: i'm looking at k8s events — node provisioning stuck in Pending with reason 'Insufficient quota' across us-west-2.

lina: can we fall back to the small-model pool in the meantime? traffic is mostly low-latency chat.

maya: yeah let's try routing to small-models as short-term. also trying manual spin up of extra nodes in the inference pool.

marco: i ran: ```kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=autoscaler -o wide``` shows control-plane crashed restarts around 10:12:05. attaching snippet: ```autoscaler-ctrl-0   CrashLoopBackOff   3   10m```

jonas: control-plane logs:
```
E0312 10:11:58 scalecontroller.go:422] failed to request instances: quote limit exceeded: 'OnDemandLimitExceeded'
E0312 10:12:01 allocator.go:87] fail to allocate: warmup request timed out
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: incident assigned to maya. Next escalation in 9m if not acknowledged by secondary.

maya: quick mitigation plan:
1) route low-priority routes to fallback small-model pool (lina to apply route change)
2) manual scale inference-nodepool to +4 using alternate instance family (jonas)
3) restart autoscaler control-plane pod after quota workaround (marco)
4) notify infra/account team to increase quota (ops)

lina: making route change now -> ```redwood-route set inference:chat --pool small-models --selector traffic.priority<=5```

lina: done. Canarying 1% traffic to small-models, UI latency dropped ~40ms for canary users.

jonas: starting manual node spin-up with an alternate family: ```gcloud compute instances create inference-burst-1 --zone=us-west2-b --machine-type=n1-highmem-8 --image=redwood-node-2026-02-10```

jonas: spun up 2 nodes, kube joined them, pods scheduled. autoscaler still unhealthy, but queue depth decreasing from 92% -> 68% within 90s.

marco: i'm going to restart autoscaler ctrl: ```kubectl rollout restart deploy/autoscaler-ctrl -n inference```

marco: rollout succeeded, ctrl pod stabilizing. logs show warmup window reducing backlog dispatch.

ops: reached out to cloud account team, raising quota case CR-789123 (requested +50 vCPUs in us-west-2). ETA 2-3 hours.

maya: customer-impact check: CS flagged 3 customers with elevated 500s and timeouts. Lina: can you confirm which customers are affected and pause non-critical background jobs?

lina: pulled the list — customer-a, customer-b, internal-demo. Paused batch rerank jobs. 500s correlate with queue timeouts > 30s.

maya: good. scan shows top-keys in prefix kv-cache warmed for routed traffic, so small-model fallback helped reduce tail timeouts.

pagerduty: Acknowledgement logged by maya at 10:14:05. Alert remains active until service checks pass.

jonas: monitoring note: if queue drains to <40% and autoscaler stabilizes, we can gradually shift traffic back. I'll prepare canary plan.

marco: followup action: add a secondary warmup strategy to autoscaler: if provisioning quota fails, try cross-zone instance families and increase warmup timeout fallback to 90s. Filed infra task INF-2034.

maya: handoff plan for next shift (sre-rotation):
- track PD incident (PD#4521), ensure queue depth < 35%
- keep manual nodes until quota bump confirmed or autoscaler recovers for 30m steady-state
- postmortem owner: jonas
- customer comms draft: ops to confirm, maya to send brief note to CS

sre-rotation: taking over at 10:28. thanks team.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident status: acknowledged -> mitigated (queue depth now 22%). Keep monitoring for 1h, then clear.

maya: closing thread for now, will open postmortem doc with timeline and RCA. :white_check_mark:
